test.name: SET-04 2 seats see mulligan declarations and history while hands and bottom choices stay private

assertions: Previous round declarations are visible to later players and every entitled observer before any redraw.
Every hand stays unchanged until the declaration round completes.
Free multiplayer redraws and paid redraws retain public counts; finished keepers cannot rejoin.
Bottom decisions are private to their owner; others never see hand identities.
Completed rounds clear public declarations, and returned observations do not alias authoritative state.
limitations: Synthetic 100-card decks isolate ordinary two/four-seat single-game setup; no eligible source-card, full-game, match-series or variant certification.
Storage fault/import and browser parity are separately executed evidence, not inferred from these pure transitions.

test.name: CR103.1 2 seats have a deterministic owned choice with no active player, priority, cards or hands before selection

assertions: The manifest seed reproducibly selects the chooser only, consuming one chance operation.
Before selection, starter/active/priority are null, no live card objects exist, no hand or library is exposed, and only the chooser owns the full-seat decision.
Wrong actor, stale revision, wrong decision, absent seat and premature mulligan leave complete state and RNG unchanged.
The undealt-inventory exception does not permit missing physical cards after selection.
limitations: Synthetic 100-card decks isolate ordinary two/four-seat single-game setup; no eligible source-card, full-game, match-series or variant certification.
Storage fault/import and browser parity are separately executed evidence, not inferred from these pure transitions.

independentReview.scope: Source and setup/index/invariants review for ordinary single-game CR103.1 choice; 40 life exists before choice only as initialized profile metadata.

test.name: CR103.1 2 seats can select A; setup order and first-draw behavior follow that choice

assertions: The explicitly selected seat is stored, becomes the first mulligan declarer and may be any seat, including someone other than the chooser.
Selection yields 100 live cards per seat: one commander in command, seven cards in hand, 92 in library, 40 life.
All commanders are placed before any library shuffle; all shuffles finish before any opening draw.
Mulligan declarations follow the seat order rotated from the selected starter, with priority absent until the first upkeep.
The selected seat receives first upkeep priority and skips the first draw only in the ordinary two-seat game; it draws to eight cards in four seats.
Starting-player metadata remains after setup, and attempting another selection cannot mutate the started game.
limitations: Synthetic 100-card decks isolate ordinary two/four-seat single-game setup; no eligible source-card, full-game, match-series or variant certification.
Storage fault/import and browser parity are separately executed evidence, not inferred from these pure transitions.

independentReview.scope: CR103.1/103.2c/103.3/103.5/103.8a/c/101.4e/903.6/903.7 against setup/index/invariants/driver in ordinary two/four-seat single games.
